rooms.name: Primary bedroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. King bed with a low headboard on the west wall, centred between the two west windows (W15 and W14, both kept, with the same two-sash unit), with a nightstand under each; the rear sliding door W01 opens to the garden. Open to the vestibule at the south-east corner (D10, 4′7″ wide, no door).

rooms.name: Bedroom 2
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Entered from the hall through the hinged door D12 (2′8″) in its south wall, as on the architect's sheet; the reach-in closet M15 opens off the same wall behind two sliding panels (D13). The rear window W02 runs from a 2′0″ sill to the ceiling.

rooms.name: Primary bathroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Laid out as on the architect's sheet: a 5′0″ × 3′0″ curbless shower in the north-west corner under the skylight W20, the toilet in the south-west corner, a 6′6″ double vanity along the south wall, the door D08 at the east end of the north wall and the window W13 on the west wall, its mullion on the shower's glass line. Walls: natural stacked stone on the vanity wall (south); every other wall plain white from the floor to the ceiling above a white tile base; matte white tile in the shower; white ceiling.

rooms.name: Shared bathroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Entered from the hall through the hinged door D07 (2′4″) in its north wall.

rooms.name: Walk-in closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. An enclosed room off the primary suite's vestibule, behind the sliding pocket door D18 (2′6″ × 6′8″) in its east wall. Hanging rods and shelves on the north, west and south walls, with a drawer and shelf tower on the west wall; no window; flush ceiling light.

rooms.name: Bedroom 4
rooms.note: Clear interior size overall; excludes walls. L-shaped: the laundry closet is taken out of the north-east corner, and the area leaves out 3′5″ × 3′3″ for the closet and its two walls. Flat 8 ft ceiling (no vault).

rooms.name: Bedroom 3
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls and the bay, which is glazed to the floor. Vaulted ceiling, 8′0″ at the side walls and 11′1¼″ at the ridge. The west wall behind the bed is solid, as on the architect's sheet. The room is entered through the hinged door D03 (2′8″); the bathroom door D05 and the closet's sliding panels D06 are in its north wall.

rooms.name: Bedroom 3 bathroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Laid out as on the architect's sheet: a shower 3′0″ wide across the west end behind a fixed glass panel, the wall-hung toilet in a 2′6″ bay and the vanity in a 2′9″ bay on the north wall, and the hinged door D05 (2′4″) at the east end of the south wall. The shower window W11 on the west wall is 3′0″ wide and runs from a 3′0″ sill to a 7′6″ head (4′6″ tall), in obscured glass with a white frame and white grid bars.

rooms.name: Bedroom 3 closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. A reach-in closet off Bedroom 3 behind two bypass sliding panels of 2′6″ in a 4′8″ opening (D06), fitted with a drawer and shelf tower, a double-hang bay and an open shelf tower.

rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.note: Clear interior size, from the shared bath's south wall to the front wall. The west wall lines up with the shared bath's east wall.

rooms.name: Bedroom 4 reach-in closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. A reach-in closet off Bedroom 4 behind two bypass sliding panels in a 5′4⅝″ opening (D16). Flat 8 ft ceiling.

rooms.name: Laundry closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size: 2′10″ wide (north to south, across the doors) and 3′0″ deep (door wall to back wall). Carved out of Bedroom 4's north-east corner; it opens east onto the foyer through the doors D17. Stacked front-load washer and dryer, each 27 × 30¼ × 39 in (width × depth × height), facing the foyer, under the 8 ft ceiling.

rooms.name: Primary vestibule
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. The passage of the primary suite: open to the bedroom over its full width (D10, 4′7″, no door), entered from the hall through D09 in its east wall, with the walk-in closet's pocket door D18 in its west wall and the bathroom door D08 at its south end. Attic access hatch (30 × 22 in) in the ceiling.

rooms.name: Bedroom 2 closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. A reach-in closet along Bedroom 2's south wall, 6′10″ wide and 1′11″ deep, behind two bypass sliding panels in a 6′0″ opening (D13): shelf, hanging rod and a shelf tower at the east end. Behind it, in the same block, stand the furnace closet and the storage closet, which open onto the hall (D19, D20).

windows.name: Primary bedroom / rear sliding door
windows.type: Two-panel sliding glass door to the garden in a 6'-4" wall opening (6'-0" clear between the frame's jambs): a fixed west panel and a sliding east panel, each 3'-1 3/8" wide; shown closed; white frame, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 5 high in each panel; landing outside

windows.name: Bedroom 2 / rear
windows.type: Tall glazing, two sashes, from a 2'-0" sill to the ceiling; white frame, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 4 high in each sash

windows.name: Living / east
windows.type: Clear glazing, one unit with two sashes; white frame, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 3 high in each sash

windows.name: Living / dining east
windows.type: Clear glazing, two unequal sashes as on the architect's sheet (the mullion stands 3'-4 1/2" from the north jamb and 1'-7 1/2" from the south jamb); white frame, white grid bars, 3 lites wide × 3 high in the north sash and 1 lite wide × 3 high in the south sash

windows.name: Kitchen / east
windows.type: Three-sash window with a flat head, over the sink; white frame, casing and stool, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 4 high in each sash

windows.name: Bedroom 3 / front
windows.type: Three-sided canted bay glazed to the floor; 8 ft wall opening; 2 ft projection; white frame, white grid bars, 3 lites wide × 5 high in the centre sash and 2 lites wide × 5 high in each side sash

windows.name: Bedroom 3 bathroom / west
windows.type: Obscured privacy glazing, two sashes; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 3 high in each sash

windows.name: Bedroom 4 / west
windows.type: Clear glazing, two sashes; white frame, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 3 high in each sash

windows.name: Primary bathroom / west
windows.type: Tall clear glazing from a 2'-0" sill to the ceiling, with a transom at 6 ft and a mullion on the shower's glass line: the north sash is inside the shower; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 3 high in each sash below the transom, one lite in each above it

windows.name: Primary bedroom / west south
windows.type: Clear glazing, two sashes; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 3 high in each sash

windows.name: Primary bedroom / west north
windows.type: Clear glazing, two sashes; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 3 high in each sash

windows.name: Kitchen skylight
windows.type: Roof glazing on the east-facing roof plane, 1'-10" x 3'-10", over the sink / dishwasher run

windows.name: High window above front entrance
windows.type: High window above the front door unit, 3 ft × 2 ft 3 in; white frame, white grid bars, 3 lites wide × 2 high; under the entry roof's front gable

windows.name: Foyer skylight (hall)
windows.type: Roof glazing on the entry roof's east slope, 2'-0" x 3'-0"

windows.name: Foyer skylight (vaulted entry)
windows.type: Roof glazing on the entry roof's east slope, 2'-0" x 2'-9 5/8"

windows.name: Primary bathroom skylight (over the shower)
windows.type: Roof glazing on the west roof plane, 2'-0" x 2'-6", over the shower

windows.name: Living room skylight
windows.type: Roof glazing on the east-facing roof plane, 1'-10" x 3'-10", over the sofa side of the living room, where the architect's sheet draws it

windows.name: Front door sidelight (west)
windows.type: Fixed sidelight of the front door unit, clear glass above a 6 in bottom rail; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 4 high

windows.name: Front door sidelight (east)
windows.type: Fixed sidelight of the front door unit, clear glass above a 6 in bottom rail; white frame, white grid bars, 1 lite wide × 4 high

doors.name: Front entrance
doors.type: Hinged on the east post, opening into the foyer; shown open 105 degrees. A 3'-0" walnut door in a white unit 5'-3" wide, which leaves 3 in of wall on each side of it, with a sidelight on each side of the door (W22, W23)

doors.name: Door between house and garage
doors.type: Hinged on the north jamb, opening east into the garage; shown open 90 degrees; self-closing. A 3'-0" door in 2 in frames (3'-4" wall opening). The garage floor is 11 in below the house floor: a 5 1/2 in riser down to a step of 1'-0" x 3'-8", a second one down to the floor

doors.name: Bedroom 3 entry
doors.type: Hinged on the north jamb, opening west into Bedroom 3; shown open 90 degrees, along the room's north wall

doors.name: Bedroom 4 entry
doors.type: Hinged on the north jamb, opening west into Bedroom 4; shown open 90 degrees

doors.name: Bedroom 3 bathroom
doors.type: Hinged on the east jamb, opening north into the bathroom; shown open 90 degrees, along the bathroom's east wall; quartz saddle

doors.name: Bedroom 3 closet
doors.type: Two bypass sliding panels of 2'-6"; shown with both panels at the east end, the west half of the closet open

doors.name: Shared bathroom entry
doors.type: Hinged on the east jamb, opening south into the bathroom; shown open 90 degrees, along the bathroom's east wall; oak saddle

doors.name: Primary bathroom entry
doors.type: Hinged privacy door on the east jamb, opening into the bathroom; shown open 90 degrees, against the bathroom's east wall

doors.name: Primary suite entry
doors.type: Sliding panel on the hall side of the wall, parked south of the opening; shown open

doors.name: Primary bedroom open connection
doors.type: Open connection between the bedroom and the vestibule beneath the retained header; no door

doors.name: Bedroom 2 entry
doors.type: Hinged on the west jamb, opening north into Bedroom 2; shown open 90 degrees, along the bedroom's west wall

doors.name: Bedroom 2 closet
doors.type: Two bypass sliding panels of 3'-0" (and the lap of their meeting stiles); shown with both panels at the west end, the east half of the closet open

doors.name: Living room rear sliding door
doors.type: Four-panel glazed sliding door to the rear landing in a 12'-4" wall opening (12'-0" clear between the frame's jambs): a fixed panel at each end and two sliding centre panels, each 3'-1 3/8" wide; shown with the east centre panel slid open, a way of 2'-3"; white frame, white grid bars, 2 lites wide × 5 high in each panel

doors.name: Garage vehicle door
doors.type: Sectional vehicle door, shown closed: 14'-10" wide between two 1 in jamb boards in the 15'-0" wall opening of the architect's sheet, 7'-0" high above the garage floor, which is 11 in below the house floor

doors.name: Bedroom 4 reach-in closet
doors.type: Two bypass sliding panels in a 5'-4 5/8" opening

doors.name: Laundry closet doors (pair)
doors.type: Pair of hinged leaves, one on the north jamb and one on the south jamb, opening east into the foyer; shown open 160 degrees. 2'-5 1/4" clear between the jamb liners of the 2'-6" wall opening

doors.name: Walk-in closet pocket door
doors.type: Sliding pocket door; the leaf slides south into the wall; shown open

doors.name: Garage side door
doors.type: Hinged on the south jamb, opening west into the garage; shown closed; lever and deadbolt. A 2'-4" door in 2 in frames (2'-8" wall opening) in the garage's east wall. It stands on the garage floor, 11 in below the house floor

doors.name: Furnace closet door
doors.type: Hinged on the north jamb, opening west into the hall; louvred leaf, shown closed. The furnace closet behind it is 3'-2" x 1'-11" clear

doors.name: Storage closet door
doors.type: Hinged on the east jamb, opening south into the hall; shown closed. The storage closet behind it is 3'-3" x 1'-11" clear

spaces.name: Furnace closet
spaces.note: Furnace (FAU) closet in the closet block between Bedroom 2 and the hall, behind the louvred door D19 in the block's west wall. Shown closed; not on the tour.
spaces.label: FAU

spaces.name: Storage closet
spaces.note: Storage closet in the same block, behind the door D20 in the block's south wall. Shown closed; not on the tour.
spaces.label: STO

spaces.name: Hall, west leg
spaces.note: The hall beside the closet block, 3′3″ wide: the primary suite's entry D09 in its west wall, Bedroom 2's door D12 at its north end, the furnace closet's door D19 in its east wall.
spaces.label: HALL 3′3″

spaces.name: Hall, east leg
spaces.note: The hall south of the closet block, 3′4″ wide, open to the living room at its east end and to the passage to the foyer on its south side.
spaces.label: HALL 3′4″

spaces.name: Garage
spaces.note: Clear interior size. The floor is 11 in below the house floor and the ceiling 8'-11" above it. Water heater: a 1'-8" tank on a stand in the north-east corner.

spaces.name: Garage step at the house door
spaces.note: One step between the house floor and the garage floor: two risers of 5 1/2 in.

spaces.name: Covered porch
spaces.note: Porch slab 5 1/2 in below the house floor, with two equal risers of 5 1/2 in, one from the front walk up to the slab and one at the door, under the entry roof's gable, which runs on 1'-0" past the slab.

spaces.name: Rear landing, living room
spaces.note: Ipe landing outside the living room's sliding door D14, 1 in below the house floor, with one step 12 in deep round its three open sides (2 risers of 6 1/2 in down to the garden).

spaces.name: Rear landing, primary bedroom
spaces.note: Ipe landing outside the primary bedroom's sliding door W01, built like the living room's.

overall.note: Outside faces of the walls: 39'-11" wide, 54'-4" deep on the Bedroom 3 side and 53'-0" on the garage side, as on the architect's sheet SKA002; every wall 5 in thick. Heights are above the house floor.
